Class PopulationChangeVector

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Integer>
java.util.AbstractList<Integer>
java.util.ArrayList<Integer>
solvers.dataStructures.EnhancedVector
solvers.dataStructures.PopulationChangeVector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnhancedVector>, Iterable<Integer>, Collection<Integer>, List<Integer>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<Integer>
public class PopulationChangeVector extends EnhancedVector
This class implements the PopulationChangeVector object, which are used in in the definition of the CoMoM basis. It extends an EnhancedVector object.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw, 2012
